current.text: He is the third-string center behind Nick Claxton and Jalen Smith.
The 10th rotation spot is open between him, Patrick Williams and Leonard Miller.
Yahoo lists him as questionable with a toe injury.
Chicago re-signed him at a high salary on a short veteran deal.
His contract likely makes him a trade piece. The front office signs older players and hopes to trade them.

durable.text: A toe injury kept him out of most of last season.
He is usually hurt a lot.
Steals are his clear weak spot. He gets very few, even for a center.

note: Both Yahoo and ESPN value him at 0 USD. His ranks (247 Yahoo, 303 ESPN) put him well outside the 144 players drafted in our league, so do not draft him. He is a third-string center with a toe problem (Yahoo Q). Projections give him only about 15 minutes and 7 points, with few steals. He only becomes a waiver option if Claxton and Jalen Smith both miss time, or if a trade sends him to a team where he gets real center minutes.
